concepts.gloss_en: The heart being guarded from the power of imagination (the faculty of המדמה)
The eye being guarded from the power of imagination — distinct organ (עין) from the heart-form

notes: Same Torah (lm1:54) and same predicate (being guarded from כח המדמה), but the guarded subject differs: הלב (heart) vs העין (eye). Per rule 4, a state about a different head is a different concept. Kept separate.
